messages.subject: Project Umbra - EXECUTED Licence Agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

Pleased to confirm the Patent and Software Licence Agreement has been executed today, 27 February 2026. Conformed PDF attached. Agreed terms as signed: £1,250,000 upfront, 7.5% running royalty, liability cap the greater of £3m / 150% with a £5m IP indemnity cap, five-year initial term, NCC escrow. Congratulations to both teams. Escrow deposit to follow within 30 days.

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
